BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,537,599 of its own ordinary shares between September 7th and September 11th, 2026, at an average price of approximately 69.9 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 73.50 pence and the lowest 66.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of issued ordinary shares to 331,594,631, which will be used by shareholders for disclosure calculations under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 14 September 2026 14 September 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 07 September 2026 08 September 2026 09 September 2026 10 September 2026 11 September 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 411,000 431,000 232,598 256,385 146,616 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 73.50 71.50 69.30 68.20 67.70 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 71.30 69.70 68.40 66.00 66.10 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 71.7318 70.5627 68.8118 66.6837 67.2195 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 335,462,271 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 331,594,631 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
